blocks.en: We begin our study of conservation laws by computing their characteristics and giving conditions under which the systems are strictly hyperbolic.
blocks.zh: 首先计算守恒律的特征, 并给出使方程组严格双曲的条件, 由此开始对守恒律的研究.

blocks.en: The proof is left to the reader. All that is involved is interpreting the definition of a characteristic curve and strict hyperbolicity for a nonlinear system in the case where the curve is described by a graph rather than a level set. (Recall the comments about different representations for surfaces in Section~\ref{sec:cauchy-kovalevskaya}.)
blocks.zh: 证明留给读者. 所需的全部工作, 就是在用函数图像而非水平集描述曲线的情形下, 解释非线性方程组的特征曲线与严格双曲性的定义. (回忆 Section~\ref{sec:cauchy-kovalevskaya} 中关于曲面的不同表示方式的说明.)

blocks.en: We now define some functions on the state space, called \emph{Riemann invariants}, that are instrumental in finding solutions to problems with discontinuous initial conditions. These functions are defined locally in a neighborhood $U\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$.
blocks.zh: 现在在状态空间上定义一些称为 \emph{Riemann 不变量}的函数, 它们在求解具有不连续初始条件的问题时十分重要. 这些函数局部定义在一个邻域 $U\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$ 上.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: def:riemann-invariant

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The following lemma gives an existence result for an appropriate system of Riemann invariants.
blocks.zh: 以下引理给出一个适当的 Riemann 不变量组的存在性结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: For every $\bar{\bm{u}}\in\mathbb{R}^n$ there is a neighborhood $\bar U\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ of $\bar{\bm{u}}$ on which there are $n-1$ $k$-Riemann invariants whose gradients are linearly independent at each point $\bm{u}\in\bar U$.
blocks.zh: 对每个 $\bar{\bm{u}}\in\mathbb{R}^n$, 都存在 $\bar{\bm{u}}$ 的邻域 $\bar U\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, 其上有 $n-1$ 个 $k$-Riemann 不变量, 它们的梯度在每个点 $\bm{u}\in\bar U$ 处线性无关.
blocks.label: lem:riemann-invariants-existence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $S$ be a smooth surface through the point $\bar{\bm{u}}$, transversal to the vector $\bm{r}_k(\bar{\bm{u}})$. In a neighborhood of $\bar{\bm{u}}$, we now consider a system of the ODEs $\mathrm{d}\bm{u}/\mathrm{d}t=\bm{r}_k(\bm{u})$. Then $w(\bm{u})$ is a $k$-Riemann invariant if it is constant along every trajectory of this system of ODEs. Now every trajectory that passes through a sufficiently small neighborhood of $\bar{\bm{u}}$ intersects $S$ exactly once. The coordinates of this point of intersection (in a suitably chosen coordinate system on $S$) will serve as our Riemann invariants.
blocks.zh: 设 $S$ 为通过点 $\bar{\bm{u}}$ 并与向量 $\bm{r}_k(\bar{\bm{u}})$ 横截的光滑曲面. 在 $\bar{\bm{u}}$ 的一个邻域内, 考虑常微分方程组 $\mathrm{d}\bm{u}/\mathrm{d}t=\bm{r}_k(\bm{u})$. 若 $w(\bm{u})$ 沿这一常微分方程组的每条轨线为常数, 它就是一个 $k$-Riemann 不变量. 现在, 每条经过 $\bar{\bm{u}}$ 的充分小邻域的轨线都恰好与 $S$ 相交一次. 交点的坐标 (相对于 $S$ 上适当选定的坐标系) 就作为所需的 Riemann 不变量.

blocks.en: The relationship between the Riemann invariants and the characteristic curves for this system is given by the following result.
blocks.zh: 以下结果给出这一方程组的 Riemann 不变量与特征曲线之间的关系.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $(w(x,t),v(x,t))$ be a $C^1$ solution of the system given above. Then the Riemann invariant $\rho_i(w(x,t),v(x,t))$ is constant along characteristic curves satisfying $\hat x'(t)=-\lambda_i(w(\hat x(t),t))$.
blocks.zh: 设 $(w(x,t),v(x,t))$ 为上述方程组的一个 $C^1$ 解. 那么 Riemann 不变量 $\rho_i(w(x,t),v(x,t))$ 沿满足 $\hat x'(t)=-\lambda_i(w(\hat x(t),t))$ 的特征曲线为常数.
blocks.label: thm:p-system-characteristic-invariants

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
We do only the calculation for $\rho_1$.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\rho_1(w(\hat x(t),t),v(\hat x(t),t))
&=v_x\hat x'+v_t-\sqrt{-p'(w)}(w_x\hat x'+w_t)\\
&=-\sqrt{-p'(w)}(w_t-v_x)+(v_t+p'(w)w_x)\\
&=0.
\end{aligned}
\]
The calculation for $\rho_2$ is identical.
blocks.zh:
只对 $\rho_1$ 作计算.
\[
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\rho_1(w(\hat x(t),t),v(\hat x(t),t))
&=v_x\hat x'+v_t-\sqrt{-p'(w)}(w_x\hat x'+w_t)\\
&=-\sqrt{-p'(w)}(w_t-v_x)+(v_t+p'(w)w_x)\\
&=0.
\end{aligned}
\]
对 $\rho_2$ 的计算相同.

blocks.en: Both the Theorem~\ref{thm:p-system-characteristic-invariants} and the diagonalization procedure above can be generalized to any system of two strictly hyperbolic conservation laws. We can also use Riemann invariants to describe a hypothesis that often holds for systems of conservation laws coming from physics.
blocks.zh: Theorem~\ref{thm:p-system-characteristic-invariants} 和上述对角化过程都可推广到任意由两个守恒律组成的严格双曲方程组. 还可用 Riemann 不变量描述一个假设, 物理中产生的守恒律方程组常常满足这个假设.

blocks.label: def:genuine-nonlinearity

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In the case of a single conservation law \eqref{eq:scalar-conservation-law-quasilinear} we have $\lambda(u)=f'(u)$ and $r=1$, so $\nabla\lambda(u)\cdot r=f''(u)$. We refer to a function satisfying $f''>0$ ($<0$) as \emph{strongly convex} (\emph{concave}). In conservation laws, such a function is sometimes referred to as strictly convex (concave). This is (strictly speaking) incorrect. Thus, genuine nonlinearity is implied by either strong convexity or concavity of $f$. Strong convexity is often assumed for physical reasons. (Variational problems that represent the steady state of conservation laws are usually stated as minimization rather than maximization problems.)
blocks.zh: 对单个守恒律 \eqref{eq:scalar-conservation-law-quasilinear}, 有 $\lambda(u)=f'(u)$ 和 $r=1$, 所以 $\nabla\lambda(u)\cdot r=f''(u)$. 将满足 $f''>0$ ($<0$) 的函数称为\emph{强凸} (\emph{强凹}) 函数. 在守恒律中, 有时将这样的函数称为严格凸 (严格凹) 函数. (严格地说) 这是不正确的. 因此, $f$ 的强凸性或强凹性都蕴含真正非线性. 出于物理原因, 常假设强凸性. (描述守恒律稳态的变分问题通常表述为极小化问题, 而非极大化问题.)
blocks.label: ex:scalar-genuine-nonlinearity

blocks.en: We should note that there are interesting physical problems that are not genuinely nonlinear. In particular, in the $p$ system the function $p$ is sometimes assumed to have an inflection point. We do not address such problems in detail in this book, but we should introduce the reader to the following terminology.
blocks.zh: 应当指出, 有些有趣的物理问题并不是真正非线性的. 特别地, 在 $p$ 方程组中, 有时假设函数 $p$ 有拐点. 本书不详细讨论这样的问题, 但应向读者介绍以下术语.
